checks.name: Neutral startup preserves 5 enemy / 4 ally unknown slots without a selected hero
Fixture data is labelled outside the app and live mode requires an explicit scenario change
Explicit base card selection exposes a narrow summary without unseen vitals or skills
Pro fixture begins neutral and does not create data permissions
Escape closes inline detail before inspector and restores card focus
Capability loss clears detail and selection while preserving event-tab choice
Right-side tabs support selected state and arrow-key focus navigation
Stale fixture clearly labels old own/CV observations and clears previous selection
GSI-only unavailable CV never invents enemy identity or age and retains own fixture values
Decorative map contains no selectable live marker
Contrast and motion controls invoke the generated token adapter attributes
Voice and opt-in specimens have no microphone or transport side effect
Embedded token download matches the canonical merged token bytes
Unknown reset removes fixture own values and disables all hero selections
All referenced CSS custom properties are defined and HTML has no duplicate ids
Bundle causes no script exception or external resource reference
